headlines.description: Rashad Greene returned a punt 63 yards, setting up Blake Bortles' 5-yard touchdown pass to Julius Thomas with 3:30 remaining, and the Jacksonville Jaguars beat the Tennessee Titans 19-13 on Thurs
headlines.shortLinkText: Greene's punt return sets up go-ahead TD for Jags

headlines.description: Adam Vinatieri kicked a 43-yard field goal with 52 seconds remaining, and the Colts overcame a pair of two-touchdown deficits to beat the slumping Falcons 24-21 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vinatieri kicks another winner as Colts beat Falcons

headlines.description: Brock Osweiler threw for two touchdowns while starting for the injured Peyton Manning, as the Denver Broncos held off the Chicago Bears for a 17-15 victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Osweiler throws for 2 TDs, Broncos beat Bears 17-15

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford ran for a go-ahead 5-yard touchdown early in the fourth quarter, and the Detroit Lions beat the Oakland Raiders 18-13 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stafford's go-ahead TD run helps Lions beat Raiders

headlines.description: Tony Romo pulled off his latest comeback victory, returning from a collarbone injury Sunday to throw for two scores, and the Dallas Cowboys won for the first time since he was hurt in Week 2.
headlines.shortLinkText: Romo returns from layoff to help Dallas beat Miami 24-14

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: Jameis Winston tied a rookie record with five touchdown passes, Doug Martin ran for 235 yards, and the Tampa Bay Buccaneers beat the Philadelphia Eagles 45-17 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Winston tosses 5 TD passes, Buccaneers beat Eagles 45-17

headlines.description: Cam Newton threw a career-high five touchdowns passes, and the Carolina Panthers improved to 10-0 on the season with a 44-16 win over the Washington Redskins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Newton throws 5 TDs, unbeaten Panthers top Redskins 44-16

events.name: St. Louis Rams at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: Justin Tucker kicked a 47-yard field goal as time expired, and the Baltimore Ravens rallied for a 16-13 win, but lost quarterback Joe Flacco for the season with a torn ACL.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens beat Rams 16-13 in error-filled game

events.name: New York Jets at Houston Texans

headlines.description: DeAndre Hopkins had two touchdown catches and Alfred Blue caught a TD pass from receiver Cecil Shorts to help the Houston Texans to a 24-17 win over the New York Jets on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Houston gets 3rd straight win with 24-17 victory over Jets

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Justin Houston intercepted Philip Rivers' pass and returned it 17 yards for a touchdown as the Kansas City Chiefs embarrassed the free-falling San Diego Chargers 33-3 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Houston's pick-6, Poe's TD run carry Chiefs over Chargers

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw for 212 yards and a pair of touchdowns, Datone Jones had two of Green Bay's six sacks, and the Packers stopped a three-game losing streak with a convincing win over Minnesota.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers, Packers beat Vikings 30-13 to even NFC North race

headlines.description: Rookie Thomas Rawls rushed for 209 yards and had two total touchdowns, Tyler Lockett caught pair of TD passes from Russell Wilson, and the Seattle Seahawks got back to .500 with a 29-13 win over
headlines.shortLinkText: Rawls runs for 209 yards as Seahawks beat 49ers 29-13

headlines.description: Chandler Catanzaro kicked a 32-yard field goal with 2 seconds remaining and the Arizona Cardinals escaped with a wild 34-31 victory over the Cincinnati Bengals on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Catanzaro's field goal after penalty gives Arizona wild win

events.name: Buffalo Bills at New England Patriots

headlines.description: James White scored the first two touchdowns of his career, one running and one receiving, and the Patriots improved to 10-0 on Monday night with a 20-13 victory over the Buffalo Bills.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots overcome pesky Bills to claim 10-0 start
